description: This Java source file defines the ModelIndex class, which models an index element in an entity model, including creation methods, XML serialization, and nested classes for fields and functions.

classes.name: ModelIndex
classes.description: Represents an index in an entity model, including properties like name, uniqueness, and fields, with methods for creation, XML conversion, and accessors.

classes.name: ModelIndex.Field
classes.description: Represents a field within a ModelIndex, including field name and optional function (LOWER, UPPER).

classes.name: ModelIndex.Function
classes.description: Enumeration of functions applicable to index fields, such as LOWER and UPPER.

methods.name: ModelIndex.create
methods.description: Creates a new ModelIndex instance with specified properties or from an XML element.

methods.name: ModelIndex.getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the index.

methods.name: ModelIndex.getUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether the index enforces a unique constraint.

methods.name: ModelIndex.getFields
methods.description: Returns the list of fields included in the index.

methods.name: ModelIndex.toXmlElement
methods.description: Serializes the ModelIndex to an XML element.

methods.name: ModelIndex.Field.getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field.

methods.name: ModelIndex.Field.getFunction
methods.description: Returns the function applied to the field, if any.
